infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Insight uses the microphone for voice journaling, Vent Mode conversations, and speech-to-text notes.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Insight uses speech recognition to convert your voice into text for journal entries and Vent Mode.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Insight needs access to your photo library so you can select a profile picture for your account.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Insight uses Face ID to quickly unlock your journal so only you can access your entries.
